name: idea.plan
description: Turns an idea into a post on a day at a stage, under the client's post id. The tile leaves the calendar; the post keeps what the tile said, so unplanning gives it back. The same plan again answers with the post it made.
sql:
with i as (select * from brandbase.ideas where id = :id and brand_id = :brand),
b as (select linked from brandbase.brands where id = :brand),
made as (
  insert into brandbase.posts (id, brand_id, format, hook, day, time, channels, media, from_idea, marked)
  select :postId, :brand, i.format, i.hook, :day::date, :time,
    case when :channels::jsonb is null then brandbase.default_channels(i.format, b.linked)
    else array(select c from jsonb_array_elements_text(:channels::jsonb) with ordinality t(c, n) group by c order by min(n)) end,
    coalesce(:media::jsonb, case when i.image is null then '[]'::jsonb
      else jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('src', i.image, 'kind', 'photo')) end),
    jsonb_build_object('why', i.why, 'suggested', i.status = 'suggested'),
    case when :stage = 'draft' then null else :stage end
  from i, b where i.post_id is null
  returning *
),
linked as (
  update brandbase.ideas x set post_id = m.id, day = null, version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from made m where x.id = :id
  returning x.*
)
select jsonb_build_object('idea', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(l)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(l.created_at), 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(l.updated_at)), 'post', brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(m), '[]')) as result
from linked l, made m
union all
select jsonb_build_object('idea', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(i)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(i.created_at), 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(i.updated_at)), 'post', brandbase.post_json(p))
from i join brandbase.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
where i.post_id = :postId and not exists (select 1 from made)
